footer.patientRights: Notice on the protection of foreign patients' rights
footer.notice: Pibu is a service where an AI agent helps you contact and compare clinics. Doctors decide on diagnosis and whether a procedure is suitable.

landing.metaTitle: Your agent talks to Korean clinics for you
landing.metaDescription: Tell your agent what you want. It organizes your conditions, gathers quotes, checks prices, books and keeps your records.
landing.title: Your agent talks to Korean clinics for you
landing.lead: Tell your agent what you want. It organizes your conditions, asks clinics for quotes, checks the prices and handles the booking.

tell.title: Tell your agent
tell.body: Chat about what you want. Your agent turns it into a condition card with the procedure, amount, budget, area, language and dates.

compare.title: Your agent compares
compare.body: Your agent asks clinics for quotes, and the platform checks them against past payment records.

book.title: Choose, book and keep records
book.body: Compare the quotes and book. Your record after the visit also helps you time the next session.

care.consent: Your information goes to a clinic only within the scope you agreed to.
care.doctor: Doctors decide on diagnosis and whether a procedure suits you. Pibu does not provide medical care.
care.records: Price checks appear as a one-to-one answer to your own request, never as a public advertisement.

signup.title: Get started
signup.lead: Sign up with your email, or pick a demo account.
signup.emailHint: No email is sent in the demo.
signup.emailError: Check the format of the email address.
signup.demoLead: These are fictional people. Picking one switches the screens to their language.

ask.label: What would you like to have done?

locked.title: About clinic matching and booking
locked.body: Clinic matching and booking are available only to foreign nationals on a short stay. Procedure records and next-session reminders are fully available.
